ctx.x: That was mostly New Orleans people that were there at the Yacht Club.

Yeah, mostly New Orleans people, of course. But, I don't know, all my friends like it. And I think it's still popular in New Orleans. They say that rhythm and blues is really popular, but I don't know, I like jazz much better. And down in the French Quarter now, they have several great bands that played in there. I know Al Hurt is one of them. He plays more or less progressive jazz. But, I don't know, he has some good old standards that really are good. And then, oh, there's Sharky.
